title: Development works for Promotion of Tourism at Manakkodam Lighthouse
summary: Tourism development works at Manakkodam Lighthouse, Alappuzha District, Kerala (Kochi Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Manakkodam Lighthouse, Alappuzha District, Kerala
sites.work: Development works for promotion of tourism

scope.item: Development works for Promotion of Tourism

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR/Bank Guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD (or MSME certificate) and technical documents to be sent by post or in person before the deadline. Tender fee Nil.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40%, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost
PAN and GST registration; key technical personnel for supervision and execution

Tender acceptance letter (Annexure IV), unconditional bid undertaking (Annexure V), Bid Securing Declaration (Annexure VI), relatives list (Annexure VII), not-blacklisted affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper (Annexure VIII)
Documentary evidence of annual turnover of last three years
notes: NIT dated 04.10.2023; two-cover online bids. Download/submission 06.10.2023 10:00 to 26.10.2023 15:00; queries by 12.10.2023 15:00; EMD original by 25.10.2023 15:00; technical bid opening 27.10.2023 15:00. Section I only (pages numbered 2-4); no file number, BOQ or scope details. Eligibility asks for a Bid Securing Declaration although an EMD of Rs 1,66,800 is also required. Header Hindi text only.
